description: "After Icebergs with a Painter" by Louis Legrand Noble is a travel narrative written in the mid-19th century. The book chronicles the author's summer voyage in 1859 with a landscape painter along the northeastern coast of British America, focusing particularly on the study and sketching of icebergs.
